title: 2 Days Tarangire, Ngorongoro Crater & Maasai Village Safari
description: This 2-day Tarangire, Ngorongoro Crater & Maasai Village Safari is perfect for travelers seeking a short yet rewarding wildlife and cultural experience from Arusha. Explore the vast savannahs of Tarangire National Park, famous for its large elephant herds and iconic baobab trees, and enjoy an authentic visit to a Maasai Village. On the second day, descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its dense wildlife and excellent Big Five sightings. This compact safari beautifully combines wildlife, culture, and breathtaking scenery.
highlights: Game drives in Tarangire National Park
Iconic baobab trees and large elephant herds
excludes: Optional activities (e.g. hot air balloon safari )

itinerary.title: Arusha – Tarangire National Park – Maasai Village
itinerary.text: After an early morning pick-up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Tarangire National Park. Enjoy a guided morning game drive through open savannahs and along the Tarangire River, spotting elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, and a wide variety of birdlife.Enjoy lunch inside the park before continuing with an afternoon game drive. Later, visit a Maasai Village for a cultural experience, where you’ll learn about Maasai traditions, lifestyle, crafts, and dances. In the evening, transfer to your lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater – Return to Arusha
itinerary.text: After an early breakfast, drive to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a half-day game drive. This unique volcanic caldera offers exceptional chances to see the Big Five, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, leopards, and the endangered black rhino, as well as hippos and flamingos.Enjoy a picnic lunch on the crater floor before ascending the rim and driving back to Arusha, marking the end of an unforgettable safari experience.

summary: This 2-day Tarangire, Ngorongoro Crater & Maasai Village Safari is perfect for travelers seeking a short yet rewarding wildlife and cultural experience from Arusha.
